condition_variants.hard_gates: 清水寺一般拝觀可入場；合法訪客區域；可見光拍攝時段有效；不得使用三腳架／單腳架／無人機
condition_variants.required_conditions: 本堂舞台與京都市街可辨；能見度足夠；濃霧／強降水未嚴重遮蔽景觀
condition_variants.boosters: 空氣透明度佳可增加京都市街層次；季節紅葉或櫻花可增加畫面特色，但不是基本 Outcome 必要條件
condition_variants.penalties: 強降水；濃霧；能見度過低；一般拝觀時間外；違反寺院攝影規範

viewpoints.note: Official Kiyomizu-dera material explicitly calls the Okuno-in view of the Main Hall stage and Kyoto cityscape a favorite visitor photo opportunity. Coordinate follows Kyoto City's protected-viewpoint designation.
viewpoints.name: 清水寺奥の院舞台 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 奥の院舞台的合法訪客範圍；僅限不妨礙參拜動線的手持攝影，不代表固定腳架位置。

spot.access_hours_source: Kiyomizu-dera official baseline opening schedule; verified 2026-09-25. Annual special night-viewing extensions are intentionally not repeated as a permanent rule.

access_note_i18n.zh-TW: 一般拝觀基準為 06:00–18:00，7–8 月通常至 18:30；年度夜間特別拝觀依官方當年日期另行公告，不視為全年夜間開放。境內禁止三腳架、單腳架與無人機，請僅手持拍攝且勿妨礙參拜動線。
access_note_i18n.en: Baseline visiting hours are 06:00–18:00, usually to 18:30 in Jul–Aug. Annual special night viewing is date-specific and is not treated as year-round access. Tripods, monopods and drones are prohibited; use handheld photography without obstructing visitors.
access_note_i18n.ja: 通常拝観は06:00〜18:00、7〜8月は通常18:30まで。夜間特別拝観は年度ごとの指定日に限り、通年夜間開放とは扱いません。三脚・一脚・ドローンは禁止です。
